topic: How an agent harness safely handles a password-reset request
learning_objective: Show how an agent harness turns a customer request into a checked, safe, and auditable action.

scenes.title: 1. Understand the request
scenes.learning_goal: Show that the harness converts an informal message into explicit intent.
scenes.example: A customer says they are locked out and need a password reset.

beats.spoken_text: A customer says, I am locked out. Please reset my password.
The harness converts that message into a precise password-reset intent.

scenes.bridge_to_next: An understood request is not yet an authorized action.

scenes.title: 2. Check context and policy
scenes.learning_goal: Show that identity context and tool policy are checked before action.
scenes.example: The account exists, but the reset tool is allowed only after identity verification.

beats.spoken_text: Next, the harness loads the account context and the password-reset policy.
Together they show whether this request is verified and permitted.

scenes.bridge_to_next: The permission result controls the next branch.

scenes.title: 3. Act or escalate
scenes.learning_goal: Show the guarded decision between tool execution and human review.
scenes.example: Verified requests use the reset tool; uncertain requests go to support.

beats.spoken_text: The harness evaluates one gate: is the reset both verified and allowed?
Yes calls the reset tool. No sends the case to a human instead.

scenes.bridge_to_next: Either branch must produce a clear response and a record.

scenes.title: 4. Respond and record
scenes.learning_goal: Show the safe answer and audit trail produced by the harness.
scenes.example: The customer receives a secure reset link and the action is logged.

beats.spoken_text: For an approved request, the tool returns a secure reset link to the customer.
Finally, the harness records what it checked, which tool ran, and the result.
